SELECT sum(amount) AS total_amount,
       sum(sequence_no) AS total_sequence_no,
       sum(quantity) AS total_quantity,
       sum(unit_price) AS total_unit_price,
       sum(tax_amount) AS total_tax_amount,
       sum(revision) AS total_revision
FROM final_v5_benchmark.scale_e7
WHERE row_id <= 75000
  AND category IN ('alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'delta')
  AND region IN ('north', 'south', 'east', 'west', 'central')
  AND event_date <= '2031-12-31'
  AND settled_date <= '2031-12-31'
  AND event_timestamp <= '2031-12-31 00:00:00'
  AND processed_at <= '2031-12-31 00:00:00';
